integration_instructions: Inspect each attempt and each accepted source for one exact model at a time before editing that model's records.

When the accepted source directly establishes the exact field and the same fact is already represented in the catalog, add a dated source-reuse resolution with the source IDs, precise claim, exact model/trim match, and caveats.

Do not mark an item resolved solely because an accepted source exists. If the claim is not integrated, the source is ambiguous, or the field remains unknown, preserve the unknown and give the exact reason and a reopening trigger.

Do not repeat searches; these fields already have accepted exact-model evidence. No price conversion, numeric inference, sibling transfer, image-rights inference, new source record, or image addition without evidence directly supporting it.
No external GitHub mutation, publication, or XHS access.
done_criteria: Inspect all 25 frozen fields and source records. Reconcile only directly supported findings using source-reuse metadata, preserve unresolved caveats, write a result matrix, accept monotonic coverage after ledger changes, run npm run check once for the batch, and run npm run image:report only if image records change.
delivery_boundary: Local worktree only. No push, pull request, merge, publication, or production change.
